Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: original Victoria 3 BUILDING icon, square small painted industrial site. Input images: Image 1 native chemical plant and Image 2 native steel mill are STYLE and FRAME references only, not subjects to copy. Image 3 is the new refined-fuel goods icon, use the same fuel can shape/colour for the large product motif in the lower-right foreground. Subject: a modest historical oil refinery viewed in three-quarter elevated perspective: red-brown brick processing house, a restrained short cylindrical distillation apparatus, two large cylindrical riveted storage tanks with simple conical tops, one brick chimney and coherent sparse connected piping. Not a modern petrochemical metropolis or futuristic skyscraper. Clear large masses, steel blue-grey vessels, brick ochre/red, soft upper-left light and hand-painted volumetric materials matching the native buildings. Thin patinated bronze rounded-square frame filling almost the canvas. Entire site and background fully opaque INSIDE the frame, alpha 255 without haze-induced transparency; ONLY the small outer corners beyond the metal frame are genuinely transparent. No text, numbers, company branding, logos, watermark, people, gears as decoration or separate UI badge. Newly invented composition, not a repaint of that photo.
